headline: Audiencias públicas sobre reparaciones en 55 Kearney Square (Valve Island) y 145 Pawtucket Street (North Canal Waste Gatehouse).
summary: Boott Hydropower, LLC ha solicitado dos permisos para trabajos en propiedades históricas, en 55 Kearney Square y 145 Pawtucket Street. Otros asuntos incluyen órdenes de comparecencia y solicitudes de cumplimiento para varias propiedades, además del calendario de 2027 y la elección de funcionarios.

review: summary: "Historic permits" (permisos históricos, e.g. certificates for work under historic review) was rendered as permits for work "en propiedades históricas", which changes the meaning. Also, "election of officers" became "elección de funcionarios", which wrongly suggests public officials rather than the board's own officers (presidencia, etc.). "Kearney Square" and "Pawtucket Street" are kept in English, which is acceptable as place names.
